title: SEC7: RSA sign/verify path broken without WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_RSA_PAD
description: crypto2dev_rsa() is called from wc_RsaFunction_ex() via wc_CryptoCb_Rsa(). At that call site, 'in' is the fully padded RSA block (DigestInfo for PKCS#1 v1.5, or full modulus-sized block), not a raw hash digest. For RSA-2048, inLen=256 bytes. The port treats info->pk.rsa.inLen as a digest length, maps it to an algo string via crypto2dev_hash_algo_name() (default: sha256 for any unrecognized size), and then checks inLen > CRYPTO2DEV_HASH_MAXLEN (64) which fires for any RSA key size >= 512-bit, returning BAD_FUNC_ARG. Result: RSA sign always fails with BAD_FUNC_ARG. The architectural fix requires either: (a) implementing WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_RSA_PAD support so the port receives the raw digest before padding, or (b) performing the DO_SIGN with raw data (pass the padded block as-is if crypto2dev supports it). The port's comment ('wolfSSL uses RSA_PRIVATE_DECRYPT for private-key operations') acknowledges the naming but misses the data format issue. This also affects RSA verify.
